bfsi.reason: ATT&CK: ransomware and data-extortion group active since July 2023. Its leak site listed a US brokerage/financial-services firm in Nov 2026 (ransomware.live); the claim is the group's own and unverified.

description: INC Ransom is a ransomware and data extortion threat group associated with the deployment of INC Ransomware that has been active since at least July 2023. INC Ransom has targeted organizations worldwide most commonly in the industrial, healthcare, and education sectors in the US and Europe.
